{{Quote|But you know that all that is Kesh came from the ''Skyborn''.|Izri Dazh, to Adari Vaal|<ref name="skyborn" />}}
In the [[Keshiri religion]], the '''Great Battle''' was the eons-long clash between the enemy races known as the [[Skyborn]] and the [[Otherside]] in the [[Star/Legends|stars]] above the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]], mirroring the [[Hundred-Year Darkness/Legends|Hundred-Year Darkness]] conflict between the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and its [[Exiles|Dark Jedi]] brethens. Riding colossal [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] [[uvak]] beasts, the Skyborn ultimately achieved victory, although not before being wounded by the Otherside. The injured Skyborn dripped [[Blood/Legends|blood]] onto Kesh's [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]], creating all of the world's landmass. Eventually, the Great Battle came to be revered as one of the main facets of the mythology of the [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] [[Species/Legends|species]].

==Prelude==
According to the [[Keshiri religion]], in the ages before the dawn of the [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] civilization, two races came into being&mdash;the benevolent [[Skyborn]] and the nefarious [[Otherside]], who came "from below." Eventually, the Skyborn and the Otherside came into conflict with one another, and they met for battle in the [[Star/Legends|stars]] above the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]], which was then entirely covered by roiling [[black]] [[Ocean/Legends|seas]].<ref name="skyborn" />

==The battle==
The Skyborn came into battle riding gigantic [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] [[uvak]] beasts against the Otherside, and the Great Battle, as it came to be called, raged for eons. Eventually, the Skyborn vanquished their enemies and were victorious, although they were wounded during the fighting. Drops of Skyborn [[Blood/Legends|blood]] fell onto Kesh's oceans, creating new land.<ref name="skyborn" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Your words glorify the Otherside, Adari Vaal. It's why you are here. You are here for preaching&mdash;''"<br />"''Teaching!''"<br />"''&mdash;telling these ''lies'' about the Great Battle to your acolytes!|Izri Dazh and Adari Vaal, during Vaal's hearings before the Neshtovar|<ref name="skyborn" />}}
The Keshiri [[Species/Legends|species]] eventually evolved on Kesh, living on the same landmass that was supposedly part of the Skyborn. At some point, a group of uvak-riders known as the [[Neshtovar]] brought back the knowledge of the Great Battle from Kesh's [[Takara Mountains|Cetajan Mountains]], and the tales of the Skyborn and the Otherside became the center of the prevalent Keshiri religion. The common tale of the Great Battle stood up somewhat to scientific criticism, as the lands of Kesh that had been mapped by [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]] showed a highly irregular and asymmetrical coastline&mdash;reinforcing the belief that the land had been formed from dripping Skyborn blood. In 5,000 BBY, [[Geology|geologist]] [[Adari Vaal]] discovered evidence contradicting the account of the Great Battle, and she began teaching students that the Keshiri landscape had in fact been formed naturally by [[Magma/Legends|lava]] flow. Vaal was called to testify before the Neshtovar, who had by then become the ruling council of Kesh. Vaal was accused of heresy and spreading lies about the Great Battle. Shortly afterward, Vaal discovered a [[Lost Tribe of Sith|group]] of crash-landed [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] in the Cetajan Mountains, who claimed to be the Skyborn and took their place as rulers of the planet.<ref name="skyborn" /> By [[4985 BBY]], the myths of the Skyborn and the Otherside, and therefore the Great Battle, had been all but eliminated from Keshiri life by the Sith, in favor of earlier tales of the Protectors and the [[Destructors]].<ref name="paragon">''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Paragon]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Great Battle was first mentioned [[John Jackson Miller]]'s [[2009]] [[eBook]], ''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Skyborn]]''.<ref name="skyborn" />
